2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted a suit for declaration of title and for permanent injunction against the opposite parties before the Senior Assistant Judge. 1st Court. Dhaka being Title Suit No. 22 of 1993 and obtained decree therein 

 3. Against the aforesaid judgment and decree defendant opposite party No. 1 took an appeal before the learned District Judge, Dhaka being Title Appeal No. 61 of 1995 which is now pending before the learned Additional District Judge. 5th Court, Dhaka for disposal. While the appeal is pending for disposal before the learned Additional District Judge, defendant opposite party No. 1 filed on 1.6.95 an application under Order 6 rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of the written statements.
